summary: I rewrote C13 (Appendices G and H) in place. The rigid-link lemma now reads as a computation of the variational predictive density, not a prior derived from the augmented joint. A rewritten remark shows why it is not a message of that joint. It double counts the constituent's evidence, while the cavity message is exact on a tree, and the functional built from it falls 0.14 to 12.98 nats below the surprisal. The paper's own no-go theorem also applies to the child-parent edge. The appendix now names four evidence-consistent readings, citing Theory Ch. 4 and Ch. 12: conditional coupling, cavity predictive, random effects, and the one-episode-lagged episode joint. The sentences at 3275 and 3411 that transferred the exact Gaussian mean-field result to the shadow dynamics are replaced. The Gaussian exception now cites the anchored Gaussian star in Supplement G Ch. G10. The Banach bound is restricted to isotropic couplings, with a short proof and the rho = 1.173 counterexample.
